    for leg2 in from_city.get(mid, []):
        final_dest = leg2['destination']
        if final_dest == 'SFO':
            continue
        common_dates = sorted(set(leg1['available_dates']) & set(leg2['available_dates']))
        if not common_dates:
            continue
        for dt in common_dates:
            p1 = leg1['dates_data'][dt].get('prices', {})
            p2 = leg2['dates_data'][dt].get('prices', {})
            options.append({
                'route': f"SFO -> {mid} -> {final_dest}",
                'leg1_id': leg1['flight_id'],

                'date': dt,
                'leg1_prices': p1,
                'leg2_prices': p2,
                'total_economy': p1.get('economy', 0) + p2.get('economy', 0),
                'total_business': p1.get('business', 0) + p2.get('business', 0),

            })
